text: The Marines reached Hungnam on the coast. But the story did not end there. In mid-December the United Nations carried out one of the largest evacuations by sea in military history. Over about two weeks ships carried more than one hundred thousand troops out of Hungnam. They also carried nearly one hundred thousand Korean civilians fleeing the North. One freighter called the Meredith Victory was built to carry just twelve passengers. It took on about fourteen thousand refugees. Not one life was lost on the voyage. Five babies were born along the way. On Christmas Eve demolition teams blew up the port. The last ships pulled away. The cost had been terrible. The First Marine Division suffered more than four thousand battle casualties. Thousands more were struck down by frostbite. Across all United Nations forces the campaign cost roughly seventeen thousand casualties. But the cost to the enemy was far greater. Chinese records later showed the Ninth Army Group lost tens of thousands killed and wounded. Tens of thousands more were taken out of action by the cold. The army group sent to annihilate the Marines was so badly broken that it could not return to battle for months. That was the strategic meaning of Chosin. Mao had ordered the destruction of the First Marine Division. Instead the Marines fought their way through a force many times their size. They brought out their wounded. They brought out their guns. And they left one of China's finest army groups too shattered to pursue. The men who survived called themselves the Chosin Few. For the rest of their lives many carried the scars of that winter. Numb fingers. Damaged feet. Memories that never thawed. They also carried something else. The knowledge that they had walked out of a trap that was meant to be their grave. Historians have compared the march to the retreat of Xenophon's Ten Thousand in ancient Greece. A fighting withdrawal so disciplined that it became a kind of victory of its own. Seventeen days. Seventy-eight miles. Forty below. And one simple decision made in the snow. We are not retreating. We are coming out together.
